task: Predict USGS BOU five-minute mean geographic X during [issuance+30m, issuance+35m), minus median X over [issuance-60m, issuance).
availabilityPolicy: OMNI and USGS historical availability is unknown. This is a retrospective, observation-causal research experiment; no operational backtest skill is claimed. OMNI times are bow-shock-nose arrival times, not original spacecraft measurement times.
exclusions: Exclude any case with a missing target/prior ground minute or a missing solar-wind feature over the previous hour. Do not fill gaps or select favorable test periods after inspecting scores.
limitations: Small purposive set of event blocks, one station and one held-out major storm; no population-level skill inference.
Mean absolute error and RMSE are amplitude metrics, not auroral visibility probabilities.
No phone data are model inputs; no phone forecast improvement is claimed.
priorInspection: May 2024 BOU source window already acquired for replay; models, features, event split and scoring protocol fixed before fitting or viewing model scores. This is not an externally preregistered study.
